51
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, August 4, 2015/Sravana 13, 1937 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy
(AYUSH); Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Defence; Finance; Health and
Family Welfare; Information and Broadcasting; Minority Affairs)
Total number of questions — 15
Law to regulate surrogacy in the
country
*151. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
there is no law to regulate surrogacy in
India due to which the practice is
developing into a big business;
(b) whether Government is also aware
that uneducated women in rural areas are
being lured with money putting them into
health risks;
(c) if so, whether Government will
frame law in this regard and the details
thereof; and
(d) whether Government has taken any
action against the organised gangs luring
women, if not, the reasons therefor?
Non-eligibility of women for debt relief
scheme
*152. SHRIMATI JHARNA DAS
BAIDYA : Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether women have not been made
eligible for the debt relief under the Debt
Waiver Scheme announced for farmers’
benefit in spite of the fact that a large
section of farming community is comprised
of women; and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor, and if not,
the details thereof?
Vacancy of Chairpersons in PSBs
*153. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) how many Public Sector Banks
(PSBs) are without a full time Chairperson
at present;
(b) since when these positions are lying
vacant and reasons therefor; and
(c) what action is being taken to fill up
these positions in the PSBs?
Extension of loan facilities and other
relief packages for tenant farmers
*154. SHRIMATI RENUKA
CHOWDHURY: W ill the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
a large number of tenant farmers, who
obtain land on lease for cultivation, are not

52
entitled to farm loan, Kisan Credit Cards
(KCCs) and other relief packages such as
crop insurance etc.;
(b) if so, the details thereof along with
the reasons therefor; and
(c) the corrective steps taken by
Government to instruct public sector banks
and insurance companies to extend farm
loans on subsidised rates of interest, crop
insurance scheme and Kisan Credit Card
facilities to tenant farmers?
Investigation into financial
irregularities in cricket
*155. SHRIMATI NAZNIN
FARUQUE: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether any step has been taken by
Government to bring back the first IPL
Chairman from abroad to investigate the
financial irregularities done in cricket; and
(b) if so, the details thereof, and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Amendment to existing laws to check
food adulteration
*156. DR. KANWAR DEEP SINGH:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of the
fact that despite sporadic inspection by the
food departments of the various States, the
menace of adulteration in food items has
not abated posing a great health hazard to
the people;
(b) if so, the measures being initiated
by  Government to ensure safety from the
adulterated food items;
(c) whether Government has any plan
to amend the existing laws with a view to
create an element of fear among the
miscreants; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Co-locating modern and traditional
systems of medicine in one place
*157. DR. T.N. SEEMA: Will the
Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPA THY, UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Central Government has
coordinated with the State Governments
for setting up of a separate Ayush
department so as to effectively implement
the various initiatives by the Central Ayush
Ministry;
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor;
(c) whether some of the Indian States
have not implemented the scheme of co-
locating modern and traditional systems in
one place because of the antipathy between
the medical streams; and
(d) if so, the details and the names of
the States and the steps taken by
Government in this regard?
Detection of polio-like symptoms in
Uttar Pradesh
*158. SHRI RAJ BABBAR: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether a year after India was
declared polio free by the World Health
Organisation, more than 200 samples have
tested positive to polio-like symptoms in
Uttar Pradesh, if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether Government has sent any
team to find out the virus which has
affected the children in Uttar Pradesh;
(c) if so, the details thereof and, if not
the reasons therefor; and

53
(d) the steps taken by Government to
fight this new disease?
Schedule for induction of Tejas Mark II
aircraft into service

DARDA: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased t

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, August 4, 2015/Sravana 13, 1937 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Ayurveda, Y oga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy
(AYUSH); Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Defence; Finance; Health and
Family Welfare; Information and Broadcasting; Minority Affairs)
Total number of questions — 160
Introduction of Y oga in schools and
colleges
1601. SHRI BHUPINDER SINGH: Will
the Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY, UNANI, SIDDHA AND
HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has any plan
to introduce Yoga in schools and colleges;
and
(b) if so, by what time, if not, the reasons
therefor?
Promotion of AYUSH in rural areas
1602. SHRI R.K. SINHA: Will the
Minister of AYUR VEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY, UNANI, SIDDHA AND
HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of schemes being
formulated/implemented for promotion of
AYUSH in rural areas;
(b) the details of allocations made and
incurred on each scheme since the inception
of this Ministry, State-wise;
(c) the details of the trained staff and
doctors available and employed, State-wise;
(d) the vision and the strategy to
promote AYUSH in the country;
(e) whether Government has formulated
any detailed programme to promote YOGA
in the country;
(f) whether there are sufficient YOGA
teachers available to meet the requirement;
and
(g) any proposal for further capacity
development to increase the number of
YOGA teachers?
Upgradation of Government Siddha
Medical College, Tirunelveli
1603. SHRIMATI VIJILA
SATHYANANTH: Will the Minister of
AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPA THY, UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY  be pleased to
state whether Government Siddha Medical
College and Hospital, T irunelveli, Tamil
Nadu which is providing extraordinary
health services like preventing the spreading

375
of Chikungunya, Dengu etc. by its unique
Nilavembu Kudineer, curing and treating
cerebral palsy children by unique herbal
powder massage therapies leading them to
speak and walk etc. would be upgraded
into a university and full fledged Research
Centre for the purpose of finding unique/
various medicinal plants all along Western
Ghats in Tirunelveli District?
Standardisation and certification of
traditional medicines
1604. DR. T.N. SEEMA: Will the
Minister of AYUR VEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY, UNANI, SIDDHA AND
HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
set up ayurvedic clinical research centres
to help scientifically validate traditional
system of healing;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State/UT-
wise including Kerala;
(c) the measures being taken by
Government to put in place a formal
mechanism/protocol to strengthen the
standardisation and certification process of
the aforesaid traditional medicines in the
country; and
(d) the procedure laid down for scientific
validation of these traditional medicines and
clinical trials of ayurvedic, unani, siddha
and homoeopathic medicines in absence of
a formal protocol to ensure their quality
and safety in the country?
Shortage of yoga teachers
1605. SHRI AJAY SANCHETI: Will the
Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY, UNANI, SIDDHA AND
HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to state:
(a) what is Government's policy so far
as yoga is concerned;
(b) whether Government proposes to
make yoga compulsory in schools;
(c) if so, whether Government has
sufficient yoga teachers to teach yoga in
schools;
(d) if not, the estimate of shortage of
yoga teachers; and
(e) how Government proposes to
remove this shortage?
Legislation for the regulation of Yoga
and Naturopathy
1606. SHRI VIVEK GUPTA: Will the
Minister of AYUR VEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY, UNANI, SIDDHA AND
HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to state:
(a) the number of  Yoga and
Naturopathy practitioners in the country,
State-wise especially in West Bengal;
(b) whether Government has issued
guidelines to State Governments to enact
comprehensive policy/legislation for the
regulation of Yoga and Naturopathy;
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
follow up action taken or proposed by
States/Union Territories especially West
Bengal; and
(d) the further measures being taken by
Government to accelerate the process of
registration and standardisation of  Yoga
and Naturopathy education in the country?
National Commission for Human
Resources in AYUSH
1607. DR. T.N. SEEMA: Will the
Minister of AYUR VEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY, UNANI, SIDDHA AND
HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to state:
(a) the present status of setting up of
the National Commission for Human

376
Resources in AYUSH with a view to
streamline the education sector in the Indian
Systems of Medicine;
(b) the medical and research facilities
created for scientific validation of AYUSH
system of medicine, State/Union Territory-
wise;
(c) the steps taken by Government for
inclusion of Ayurveda and Naturopathy
into the syllabus of the school education to
provide basic knowledge of the system to
the students; and
(d) the number of AYUSH gram
